lists.printed_count_quote: The ordinary papers were sent to thirty stations on the Hast Coast of Scotland, Faroe, and Iceland, as in former years. Twelve stations on this coast have sent in forty-two schedules out of the twenty-six E.C. stations of Scotland.
lists.columns: Asterisks under year columns '79–'83 (header at line 364, no sentence explains them); map number (4–29); station and district; height of light in feet; keeper's name. Sub-headings ORKNEY, MAINLAND. The count includes the 'Land Notes.—7s. Fair Isle.' line; nos. 1–3 are absent.

lists.lead_quote: The East Coast stations included in this report are as follows, those making returns being marked with a star (*) :—
legend_quotes: those making returns being marked with a star (*) :—
+ For nature of light, position, and distance from the nearest land, see Report for 1880.
lists.printed_count_quote: PrInTED schedules and letters of instruction were forwarded to thirty-seven lighthouses and light-vessels on the East Coast of England, and two stations in the Channel Islands, and returns have been received from twenty-five, against thirty in 1882.
lists.columns: A star marks stations that sent returns (25 starred); station name with L.H./L.V. (often garbled); observers' names. No map numbers. A footnote and page break (2088–2092) interrupt it before South Foreland, Casquets and Hanois.

lists.printed_count_quote: ScHEDULES were sent to thirty-four stations, as in previous years. We have received filled schedules from seventeen stations.
lists.columns: Asterisks under year columns '79–'83 (headers at 3758 and 3801, no sentence explains them); map number (81–115, no. 106 missing); station and district; height in feet; keeper's name. Sub-headings OUTER HEBRIDES and MAINLAND, SKYE, AND INNER HEBRIDES. Unnamed nos. 116–120 (3836–3840) are not counted.

legend_quotes: x = Schedule returned partly or wholly filled.
* = No schedule sent to this station.
lists.printed_count_quote: In the spring of 1883 schedules were forwarded to forty-two stations, Arklow North Lightship having been added to those of the previous year. Twenty-five replied.
lists.columns: Number (1–40, plus 5.* and 8.*); station and county; spring and autumn marks (o/x/*); a figure that is probably miles from shore; names of observers. Header line 4995 is garbled: 'G& 4 shore. Names of Observers.' Nos. 9 and 35 are missing, probably Wicklow Head and Loop Head dropped by the OCR, so 40 rows against the printed 42.
